1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __without disrupting embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __to determine embryo genotype prior to germination__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __based on the genotype determination__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of __a solution that does not chemically disrupt cell membranes, such as__ water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a multi-step process comprising__ exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are __performed in multiple cycles to maximize DNA yield__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a process comprising__ heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __performed in a manner that preserves DNA integrity__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are __performed in multiple cycles__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall-degrading__ enzyme.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __purifying and__ extracting the DNA.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by __contacting the shed cellular material with__ magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __marker-based__ genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without destroying embryo viability__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __using the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, __selective__ whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination, thereby enabling selection of embryos with desired genetic markers before committing resources to plant development__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __to produce plants carrying the desired genetic markers__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __based on genotype analysis__ is automated.
